data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'rahim' (meaning 'compassion'), Maraam signifies a guide, companion, or protector. The name Maraam carries the meaning “Guide, Companion” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian.
